data.content: Plan approved. Implement as planned, plus two review refinements: (1) handle the release_blocked -> blocked escape-state outcome, setting blocked_from_state correctly and still clearing the lease, with a test; (2) make --outcome compose with --dry-run, asserting no state/lease mutation. Start with src/failure_outcome.rs (resolution + rejection), then src/app/state_fail_ops.rs (single-FileLock state change + lease clear + Failed step close + lease termination), then CLI wiring, then prompt/bundle regeneration and the parity test.
